changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/12288-marketplace-install-mode.md`

- names `marketplaceApi.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceApi.ts` — edited by this change

  > **Clause-②: yes (widening)**: `@object-ui/i18n`'s ten locale packs gain nine keys under `marketplace.install` (`mode.label`, `mode.managed`, `mode.managedHint`, `mode.unmanaged`, `mode.unmanagedHint`, `mode.required`, `unmanagedSuccess`, `unmanagedStrippedLocks`, `unmanagedIgnored`). Nothing else on either package entry changes. `installLocal`'s new optional `installMode` input, `getDeclaredInstallModes` and the `LocalInstallMode` / `LocalInstallResult` types live in `marketplaceApi.ts`, which ships inside `dist/` but is not exported from the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry. `MarketplacePackagePage`, which is exported, keeps its props.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `96fa4b9bc` (merge-base with origin/main): 25 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 593 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (613 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/38928071627)

Inputs: card #12675 with every comment (claim `6217043127`, dev report `6218334568`), the ruling `6216295104` on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23892, the PR body and file list, the net diff of the head against its merge-base with `origin/main` (`f8267df93a`; the head's merge of main is excluded), and the check-runs on the head. Check-runs on the head: every run completed with conclusion `success` — Lint, Type Check, Build and E2E, Build Docs, Bundle Analysis, Repo Gates, Line Citation Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Changeset Declaration, Changeset Claim Re-read, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Changeset Overwrite Report, Test, Test (dist pins), Test shards 1 to 16 of 16, Live E2E (informational), label — and the coverage matrix and dependabot runs read `skipped` by their own conditions. None failed. Those conclusions are the gate verdicts; nothing was built, run or re-run here.

### ① Derived judgments

Narrowing half

- Removal of `marketplace.installedTitle`, `installedSubtitle`, `installedEmpty`, `installedAt`, `installedBy`, `installedPackageId` and `cachedAs` from all ten packs — RIGHT. The readers at the merge-base were exactly the retired list body (`InstalledListWidget.tsx` read `installedEmpty`, `installedAt`, `installedBy`, `installedPackageId`, `cachedAs`), the retired page header (`MarketplaceInstalledPage.tsx` read `installedTitle`, `installedSubtitle`) and the two deleted widget tests. At the head no code, test or doc in objectui reads any of the seven (the remaining `installedAt` / `installedBy` hits are wire fields of the install-local entry, not pack keys), and objectstack's source tree reads none. Each pack loses the same seven, so key parity across the ten holds. Two of the removed values carried inline markup rendered through `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`; both sinks leave with them. The `marketplace` pack namespace only shrinks (ADR-0060 rule 3). Outside this repo the key set is a published surface of `@object-ui/i18n`; the changeset names each key and the host consequence (the key comes back instead of a sentence) — the one line it still lacks is in ②.
- `marketplace:installed-list` now renders a replacing `Navigate` to `packagesHref(base, 'marketplace')`, and its registration (`namespace: 'app-shell'`, `inputs: []`) is unchanged — RIGHT. objectstack's `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-ui.ts` still composes the served `marketplace_installed` page from `{ type: 'marketplace:installed-list' }`, so that page resolves at this head (pinned: `ComponentRegistry.get` returns a function and lands on `/apps/setup/component/developer/packages?source=marketplace`). Until objectstack#23933 retargets the entry, the served page's own title block draws for an instant before the redirect — cosmetic, and the follow-up removes it.
- `MarketplaceInstalledPage` is still exported (`src/index.ts`) and both `system/marketplace/installed` routes stay (`AppContent.tsx`, the no-active-app block and the app block) — RIGHT. Each redirect keeps the app segment, and with no app segment lands on `/apps/setup`, a spelling `AppContent` already recognises. MarketplacePage's "Installed (N)" button still targets the legacy route, so it reaches Packages through one redirect; that file is #12662's and the claim kept it out of this PR.
- The two deleted `InstalledListWidget.*` test files — RIGHT under the duplicate rule. Every assertion has a counterpart in `MarketplaceRowActions.installedAppsPins.test.tsx` at a layer at least as close (the real `PackagesPage` and the real `marketplaceApi` over one stubbed wire): the 11645 badge and reason, the narrowed caller, the loaded control, DELETE for the manifest id with the re-read listing dropping the row (two GETs), the not-loaded and loaded confirm and result sentences, an unknown refusal code named; the 12610 tooltip, accessible description, sr-only copy, no note on a not-loaded row, no note with no install, all ten packs plain text; the 7611 walled refusal shows the door's sentence and the row stays. The 10331 InstalledList date face is dropped because no install date is drawn any more (the MarketplacePage face stays pinned), and the 7611 InstalledList row case moved into the carried file.

Widening half

- The Source derivation (`packageSource.ts`) — RIGHT. Closed set `code`, `marketplace`, `authored`. `writable === true` gives `authored`; `false` and listed by the marketplace gives `marketplace`; `false` and not listed gives `code`; a non-boolean `writable` is refused as `PACKAGE_SOURCE_UNKNOWN` and a writable row the marketplace also lists as `PACKAGE_SOURCE_CONFLICT`; a refusal names the id and replaces the list with no rows (pinned). On the objectstack side, `withWritableVerdict` stamps `writable` on every `GET /packages` row after the projection (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, pinned there by `packages-serializable-response.test.ts`), and `isWritablePackage` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/package-writability.ts`) answers `false` for every `engine.manifests` member — a booted code package and an install-local install registered through `registerApp` alike — and for the read-only scopes, `true` otherwise. So the join is exact today and each value traces to one named signal. `InstalledPackageSchema` (`package-registry.zod.ts`) and the `GET /packages` response in `package-api.zod.ts` declare neither `writable` nor an origin key: the read is of a served, undeclared key, and the sound interim form of that read — strict, absence refused, no alias and no `??` in the consumer — is what the diff has, with the contract-first half filed as objectstack-ai/objectstack#23972 (open). With the capability off, nothing is read from the marketplace and every non-writable row reads `code`.
- The marketplace list read — RIGHT. `readMarketplaceInstalls` takes the control plane's list when `connected`, otherwise the strict `fetchLocalInstalls` (a non-ok answer or one with no `items` array throws); the Packages load joins the two reads with `Promise.all`, so an unreadable listing refuses the whole list instead of relabelling installs as `code` (pinned). The install-local listing door's floor is authenticated → 200 with narrowed fields, so a non-admin Packages viewer still gets rows; `listInstalledPackages` folds a non-ok control-plane answer into `connected: false`. `listLocalInstalls` keeps its tolerant shape for the marketplace pages, as the acceptance notes say. A cloud-listed install with no registry row gets a row with no status and Details only.
- The row-action gates — RIGHT. The Actions column renders only when `getRuntimeConfig().features.installLocal` and `useWorkspaceAdminStatus().isAdmin` both hold, the two gates Installed Apps had (pinned for a non-admin and for the capability absent, the latter also asserting that no marketplace request is made); Uninstall only when the list is this runtime's ledger; the confirm is the in-app `AlertDialog`; `stopPropagation` keeps the row's detail sheet closed (pinned). A refused install with no registry row keeps its row, its Not loaded reason and its Uninstall (pinned).
- No second copy — RIGHT. `MarketplaceRowActions` calls the existing `uninstallLocal` with the existing pack sentences; Update and Re-seed / Purge stay in `MarketplacePackagePage`, reached by Details.
- `?source=` — RIGHT. `source` is not in `RESERVED_URL_PARAMS` (`urlParams.ts`); `readSourceFilter` over `getAll('source')` refuses an unknown value, the empty value and a repeated param by name, with no rows drawn (pinned for all three). The nav-item spelling the changeset publishes holds in code: `resolveHref`'s `component` case (`packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`) serialises `item.params` as the query string, so `{ type: 'component', componentRef: 'developer:packages', params: { source: 'marketplace' } }` yields `/apps/APP/component/developer/packages?source=marketplace`.
- The pending changeset `.changeset/12288-marketplace-install-mode.md` — still TRUE at this head: `marketplaceApi.ts` gains `fetchLocalInstalls` and `readMarketplaceInstalls`, `src/index.ts` still exports nothing from it, and the nine `marketplace.install.*` keys are untouched.
- Carried note, not this PR's defect: `marketplace.installedAdditiveNote`, now the row Uninstall's tooltip, is the sentence objectui#12684 reports as stale; the carry is faithful and that card owns the fix.

### ② Semver level

- `@object-ui/i18n: minor` — matches objectui's rule that a breaking change in the fixed group is `minor` with its breaking meaning in the body; the body names the seven keys, the one reader that left, and the host consequence.
